tactics.name: elliptic_curve_rank
tactics.description: Compute or verify elliptic curve rank over Q
tactics.example: theorem rank_computation (E : EllipticCurve Q) : rank E.rationalPoints = 1 := by elliptic_curve_rank

tactics.name: l_function_zeros
tactics.description: Verify L-function vanishing order at s=1
tactics.example: theorem l_function_order (E : EllipticCurve Q) : vanishing_order (l_function E) 1 = rank E.rationalPoints := by l_function_zeros

tactics.name: mordell_weil_structure
tactics.example: theorem mordell_weil_iso (E : EllipticCurve Q) : E.rationalPoints ≅ Z^r ⊕ T := by mordell_weil_structure

tactics.name: heegner_points
tactics.description: Use Heegner points to construct rational points
tactics.example: theorem heegner_construction (E : EllipticCurve Q) (D : ℤ) : ∃ P ∈ E.rationalPoints := by heegner_points D

tactics.name: sha_boundedness
tactics.example: theorem sha_finite (E : EllipticCurve Q) (p : Nat) : Finite (sha E p) := by sha_boundedness

tactics.name: galois_cohomology
tactics.example: theorem galois_cohom (E : EllipticCurve Q) (p : Nat) : H¹ Q (E.pTorsion p) = _ := by galois_cohomology

proof_strategies.name: Rank Zero Verification
proof_strategies.approach: Verify E(Q) is finite by computing torsion and showing no independent generators

proof_strategies.name: Rank One via Heegner Points
proof_strategies.approach: Use Gross-Zagier: show L'(E,1) ≠ 0 ⟹ rank ≥1, find Heegner point of infinite order

proof_strategies.name: Rank Two Investigation
proof_strategies.approach: Search for curves with proven rank 2, verify L(E,1)=0, L'(E,1)=0, L''(E,1)≠0

proof_strategies.name: L-Function Analytic Continuation
proof_strategies.approach: Prove L(E,s) extends to entire function via Mellin transform and modular form theory

proof_strategies.name: Sha Finiteness Bound
proof_strategies.approach: Use Kolyvagin's method to bound Sha(E)[p^∞], then use p-descent
